text:
Maya (Onboarding): Hi team  kicking off Solstice Retail onboarding. Objective: pilot storefront in 30 days, handoff by day 45. Need to lock owners, measurable success criteria, and any obvious blockers. Quick 25m kickoff today/tomorrow?

Eli (CSM): I can do tomorrow 10:30am PT. I'll run weekly health checks and customer comms.

Noah (Solutions Eng): 10:30 PT works. Please share infra point-of-contact (VPC/allowlist) and data sensitivity notes.

Rhea - Solstice Retail (Customer): 10:30am works. We'll start in hosted sandbox but want VPC peering later. I'll share infra POC + prompt set (~7k) before the meeting.

Maya (Onboarding): Draft success criteria to validate in kickoff: 1) sandbox E2E integration working for key flows; 2) acceptance pass on labeled prompts; 3) 95th pct latency <350ms for typical 256-token requests in pilot env; 4) enablement session recorded + runbook delivered; 5) baseline 30-day DAU target defined for renewal signals. Any additions?

Arjun (Renewals): Add procurement_watch  they mentioned a finance review in ~45 days. I'll tag renewal_risk = medium until procurement completes.

Kira (Enablement): I'll prepare a 30-min enablement pack (slides + recording) and a short troubleshooting cheat sheet. Suggest a live Q&A on day 5 post-integration.

Noah (Solutions Eng): Tech checklist I'll bring: API key, model recommendation (redwood/opt-13b-quant for cost/latency balance), sample payloads, and a small load-test plan. Sanity curl to run after key issued:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood/test-small","input":"hello"}'
```

Maya (Onboarding): @calendar-bot create 25m kickoff tomorrow 13:30 ET / 10:30 PT. Agenda: intros, confirm success criteria, infra checklist, milestones & owners, enablement timeline.

calendar-bot: Event "Solstice Retail  Onboard Kickoff" scheduled 2026-08-04 13:30 ET. Invitees: Maya, Eli, Noah, Rhea, Kira, Arjun.

Rhea - Solstice Retail (Customer): I'll upload prompts and infra POC before kickoff and confirm VPC timeline.

Maya (Onboarding): Action items recap:
- Rhea: infra POC + prompt S3 link (before kickoff)
- Noah: tech checklist + load-test template (1 day post-kickoff)
- Eli: 30/60/90 health plan + DAU targets (3 days)
- Kira: enablement pack + recording (day 5)
- Arjun: add procurement_watch and renewal note in CRM

Eli (CSM): I'll also add a day-14 pulse survey to capture early product feedback.

Maya (Onboarding): Risk note: if Solstice requires private deployment up-front, expect a 3-4 week timeline extension. Rhea please confirm by EOD.

Rhea - Solstice Retail (Customer): We'll start in sandbox for pilot and confirm peering timeline by EOD. See you at kickoff.

Maya (Onboarding): Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll run the kickoff and share notes + owner tracker after.
